findings.title: Hospital Beds for the Nation’s Sickest Kids Are Disappearing
findings.publisher: KFF Health News (republished by Flathead Beacon)
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Community Medical Center in Missoula, Montana, ended pediatric intensive care services in October
findings.access_consequences: Missoula Community Medical Center ended pediatric intensive care in October 2026. The sickest children needing ventilator support or continuous critical-care monitoring now require stabilization and transfer to another PICU; hospital CEO identified Kalispell, about 150 miles away, as the nearest in-state alternative. Other pediatric inpatient care, NICU, emergency care and stabilization services continue.
findings.affected_population: Critically ill pediatric patients in the Missoula region who need PICU-level care; hospital CEO estimated approximately 25 patients per year.
